title: Qt: FieldFilterEdit only accepts single fields
description:
FieldFilterEdit is used for cases like the I/O Graph where we only
accept a single field. Don't show the syntax as green for filter
expressions consisting of more than one field, only test for a single
field. Don't show a pop-up if there's more than one word token, since
that won't be accepted.

Remove some unused functions that were copied over from
DisplayFilterEdit that don't apply to validating single fields.

Qt: FieldFilterEdit only accepts single fields

FieldFilterEdit is used for cases like the I/O Graph where we only
accept a single field. Don't show the syntax as green for filter
expressions consisting of more than one field, only test for a single
field. Don't show a pop-up if there's more than one word token, since
that won't be accepted.

Remove some unused functions that were copied over from
DisplayFilterEdit that don't apply to validating single fields.
